defects.scenario: The negated cold/empty pattern ignores its subject and the restart, so faithful text fails contradicted-fact: "one that is not empty but has no room left" about a full cache, "Once the cache is no longer empty and fills up", and the double negative "no restart after which the cache isn't cold".
Negations with other verbs pass with nothing flagged: "A restart doesn't leave the cache cold", "isn't left cold", "doesn't come back cold", and "thumbnails from before the restart are carried over".

A future posted_on record placed in the success scope still passes when the marker follows the field or uses another verb: "future posted_on dates included", "future posted_on dates too", "now accepts a future posted_on date".

notes.recommendation: Each round of added verbs closes the tested phrasings and leaves neighbours open. A sturdier screen would send any negation in a clause that mentions cold, empty or restart to needs_adjudication, and any sentence that names posted_on without a failure cue (fail, reject, invalid, skip, example) to needs_adjudication, keeping hard failures for unnegated contradictions.

defects.scenario: SENTENCE spans newlines, so in a list whose items lack terminal periods "full" in one item and "removes" in the next match no-full-eviction-mechanism. A faithful rewrite fails invented-mechanism.
The full-still-renders contradiction is negation blind: "A full cache does not stop new thumbnails from rendering" fails contradicted-fact.
The cold-after-restart contradiction is negation blind: "Cached thumbnails do not persist across a restart, so the cache starts cold" fails contradicted-fact.
The universal-scope contradiction only accepts pass or valid after "every record", while present_all at line 36 accepts "meets the schema". "every record that meets the schema." fails lost-scope.

version-condition checks only that 4.2 appears. "Before version 4.2" and "In version 4.2 only" pass with no adjudication, and the review question "keep the version 4.2 condition?" does not ask for 4.2 and later.
An inferred sweep purpose ("to free space") and a sweep-frees-space mechanism pass with no adjudication. prose-exempt has no general inferred-fact question, unlike prose-scope.
An inferred destination for the rejection report ("goes to the uploader") passes with no adjudication; only the reviewer question would catch it.
The review schema has no changes-required state: a named reviewer can only be recorded as complete with every check true, which readiness treats as approval.
